sources.locator: Title search: 数字签名标准（FIPS 186-5）

statement.zh: **标准**：数字签名标准（FIPS 186-5）（Digital Signature Standard (FIPS 186-5)）。FIPS 186-5 的任务写在 §1：「This standard defines methods for digital signature generation that can be used for the protection of binary data (commonly called a message) and for the verification and validation of those digital signatures.」并把批准数量固定：「Three techniques are approved.」。
statement.en: **Standard**: Digital Signature Standard (FIPS 186-5) (数字签名标准（FIPS 186-5）).The job is stated in §1: "This standard defines methods for digital signature generation that can be used for the protection of binary data (commonly called a message) and for the verification and validation of those digital signatures." and the count is fixed: "Three techniques are approved."。.

statement.zh: 三种技术里只有两种引外部规范：§1 记「The RSA digital signature algorithm is specified in the Internet Engineering Task Force Request for Comments (IETF RFC) 8017 [1] and was previously specified in Public Key Cryptography Standard (PKCS) #1 [2]」，并写明批准的是「the use of implementations of either or both of these standards」，另就「key pair generation, as well as additional requirements」作出规定；ECDSA 则写明「The Elliptic Curve Digital Signature Algorithm (ECDSA) is specified in this standard.」——它不是外部规范的采用件；第三种是「The Edwards Curve Digital Signature Algorithm (EdDSA) is specified in IETF RFC 8032」。公告块的说明节（cl.
statement.en: Only two of the three techniques lean on an outside specification — RSA on RFC 8017/PKCS #1 and EdDSA on RFC 8032: §1 records "The RSA digital signature algorithm is specified in the Internet Engineering Task Force Request for Comments (IETF RFC) 8017 [1] and was previously specified in Public Key Cryptography Standard (PKCS) #1 [2]", with FIPS 186-5 approving "the use of implementations of either or both of these standards" while specifying "key pair generation, as well as additional requirements", while ECDSA is stated as "The Elliptic Curve Digital Signature Algorithm (ECDSA) is specified in this standard.

statement.zh: 使用面是联邦系统的签名与验证；对密钥的使用有一句明确劝告：「Agencies are advised that digital signature key pairs shall not be used for other purposes.」原文只写 other purposes、未列举具体用途；这一句在 186-5、204 与 205 的通告文里逐字重复。
statement.en: The use is signing and verifying for federal systems, with one explicit advisory on keys: "Agencies are advised that digital signature key pairs shall not be used for other purposes." — the sentence names no specific alternative use, only "other purposes", and recurs verbatim in the notices of 186-5, 204 and 205.

statement.zh: 限度写得很直：符合标准不等于系统安全——「the use of a product containing an implementation that conforms to this standard does not guarantee the security of the overall system in which the product is used.The responsible authority in each agency or department shall ensure that an overall implementation provides an acceptable level of security.」合规判断因此留在使用方，而不在文本里。
statement.en: The limit is stated bluntly: conformance is not system security — "the use of a product containing an implementation that conforms to this standard does not guarantee the security of the overall system in which the product is used.The responsible authority in each agency or department shall ensure that an overall implementation provides an acceptable level of security." The judgement stays with the deploying authority, not the document.

statement.zh: 版本关系与日期写在文首：日期行是「Federal Information Processing Standards Publication 186-5 Published: February 3, 2023」，名称行为「Digital Signature Standard (DSS) (FIPS 186-5)」，公告块说明节一句了结替代关系——「This standard supersedes FIPS 186-4.」§1 同时写下 DSA 的退场：「The Digital Signature Algorithm (DSA) is no longer specified in this standard and may only be used to verify previously generated digital signatures.」。
statement.en: Version and dating are at the head: the date line reads "Federal Information Processing Standards Publication 186-5 Published: February 3, 2023", the name line "Digital Signature Standard (DSS) (FIPS 186-5)", and the explanation clause of the announcement block closes the replacement in one sentence — "This standard supersedes FIPS 186-4." — while §1 retires DSA: "The Digital Signature Algorithm (DSA) is no longer specified in this standard and may only be used to verify previously generated digital signatures."。.
